items.title: Diablo II
items.brief_zh: 《Diablo II》把一代“刷怪、捡装备、升级”的核心循环做得更大、更深，同时守住“我们做的是Diablo，不是CRPG”这条底线，销量也远超前作。
items.brief_en: Diablo II made the first game's loop bigger and deeper while keeping it recognizably Diablo, and it sold far more than its predecessor.
items.background_zh: Blizzard在《Diablo》大获成功后决定做续作，由Blizzard North团队开发，前后用了三年多。团队既想补上一代没有时间做的内容，又担心加入太多复杂度，会丢掉原作的简单乐趣。
items.conclusion_zh: 文章在职业系统一节中途截断，没有写完。作者最后落在：续作在规模和系统上都变大、变深了，但仍然是一款Diablo。
items.background_en: Blizzard's Diablo was a big hit, so the Blizzard North team made a sequel over three years. They wanted to add content they had no time for in the first game, but worried that too much complexity would lose what made the original fun.
items.conclusion_en: The article breaks off in the class-system section without a final verdict. It ends on the author's position that the sequel got bigger and deeper and still felt like a Diablo game.
points_zh: 续作的每项改动都要过同一个标准：是否还像Diablo。团队为此在三年开发中反复争论，复杂度加到什么程度就算过头。美术兼对话编剧Phil Shenk回忆，开发途中有时会觉得自己在破坏原有的配方。
续作的规模大了很多，地图也从一条线性的地下城变成可以自由探索的野外。全作分四章，前三章每章都和一代一样大，最后一章在地狱，稍短一些。每章都有类似Tristram的据点，任务和路标引导玩家，地形大多随机生成，只有任务结尾处有手工设计的场景。作者认为，这让通关时长从约12小时变成约40小时。
续作把职业从三个增加到五个，目的是让角色在后期仍然保持差异。一代的战士、盗贼、法师可以学其他职业的技能，结果角色越练越像。续作新增的职业包括Necromancer、Amazon、Paladin、Sorceress和Barbarian，团队还借鉴了4X策略游戏Master of Orion的思路来解决这个问题。原文在这里截断，没有写到具体做法。
续作的销量和硬件门槛都很突出。首批印制200万份，六周卖完；首日卖出18.4万份，吉尼斯世界纪录认定它是销售最快的电脑游戏。它固定以640×480分辨率运行，233 MHz Pentium I加32 MB内存基本能跑，3D显卡只是可选。
开发期间的加班代价很大。最后18个月几乎一直在crunch，每周常超过80小时。不少人因此离职或感情破裂，David Brevik的婚姻也受到影响。Jonathan Stone说，这是他经历过最糟的一次crunch。
points_en: Every change had to pass one test: does it still feel like Diablo. The team argued for three years about how much complexity was too much. Art and dialogue writer Phil Shenk recalled that during development they sometimes felt they were ruining the formula.

The sequel is much bigger, and the map is open countryside instead of a line of dungeon levels. The game has four acts. The first three are each about as large as the first game, and the final act in Hell is a bit shorter. Each act has a home base like Tristram, quests and waypoints guide the player, and most terrain is randomly generated. The author puts the change at about 12 hours of play becoming about 40.

The sequel raised the number of classes from three to five to keep characters distinct late in the game. In the first game, classes could learn each other's skills, so characters grew more alike over time. The new classes are Necromancer, Amazon, Paladin, Sorceress and Barbarian. The team also borrowed an idea from the 4X strategy game Master of Orion to address the problem. The article breaks off before explaining how.

Sales and hardware requirements stood out. The first print run was 2 million copies, which sold out in six weeks. 184,000 copies sold in the first 24 hours, and Guinness named it the fastest-selling computer game. It ran at a fixed 640x480 resolution on a 233 MHz Pentium I with 32 MB of memory, and a 3D card was optional.

Development cost the staff heavily. The last 18 months were nearly constant crunch, often over 80 hours a week. Several divorces and breakups followed, including David Brevik's marriage. Jonathan Stone called it the worst crunch he had ever experienced.

items.title: Premium: Bursting Bubbles
items.brief_zh: 作者认为泡沫总是不稳定且具有破坏性，只对最富有的人有利；他判断，当前的AI热潮也是一个正在走向破裂的泡沫。
items.brief_en: The author argues that bubbles are destructive and mainly benefit the richest people, and that today's AI boom is a bubble on its way to bursting.
items.background_zh: 作者针对的是AI热潮中的大量资金投入：超大规模云厂商（hyperscalers）投入了数百亿美元购买GPU，银行借出了数千亿美元，AI创业公司也融资了数千亿美元，却很少有人公开讨论收入。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者认为AI泡沫尚未破裂，但已经在破裂的路上。这期付费文章接下来会讨论可以用哪些监管办法和社会手段，阻止任何行业再次炒作出虚高的估值。
items.background_en: The author is responding to the AI investment boom. Hyperscalers spent tens of billions of dollars on GPUs, banks lent hundreds of billions, and AI startups raised hundreds of billions, while few people discussed revenue.
items.conclusion_en: The author says the AI bubble has not burst yet but is on its way to doing so. The paid issue will discuss regulatory and social measures that could stop any industry from inflating speculative valuations again.
points_zh: 泡沫靠的是媒体和“看多者”的推崇，而不是对事实的讨论。作者认为，媒体容易相信大数字、大公司和所谓“有经验”的人，又只会跟随共识，还有记者想和科技高管交朋友。看多者会说“显然是泡沫，但最后会有赢家”，却从不说出谁会赢。
作者拿AI和Meta的元宇宙做对比。Meta把公司改名为Meta，在元宇宙上花了700亿美元，两年后就放弃了。作者认为，AI的不同之处在于它有可以投机的东西，还有面向消费者的产品，记者看一眼就会相信其他承诺。
作者说，质疑AI收入或Anthropic盈利能力的人会被视为别有用心。超大规模云厂商不披露AI赚了多少钱，只说云业务增长是因为AI。OpenAI在2024年亏损50亿美元，但人们仍认为，这些钱将来某天可能很值钱。
作者认为，这种现象是系统性的，因为很多人从泡沫中受益。记者有了新题材，银行有了新投资标的，风险投资有了投钱的地方，政府也有了可以说经济会持续增长的依据。
points_en: Bubbles are kept alive by media and boosters, not by careful analysis. The author says the media too easily believe big numbers, big companies and people with experience, tend to follow consensus, and some reporters want to be friends with tech executives. Boosters say a bubble will have winners but never name them.

The author compares AI with Meta's metaverse. Meta renamed the company Meta, spent $70 billion on the metaverse, and dropped it two years later. The author says AI is different because there is something to speculate on and a consumer product that journalists can look at before believing the other promises.

The author says people who question AI revenue or Anthropic's profitability are treated as acting in bad faith. Hyperscalers do not say how much money AI makes, and OpenAI lost $5 billion in 2024. People still accept that the money might be worth a lot someday.

The author says the boom is systemic because many groups benefit from it. Journalists get new topics, banks get new investments, venture capitalists get places to put money, and governments get a story of continued growth.

items.title: Quoting Levent Alpöge
items.brief_zh: Levent Alpöge称，他与Claude合作找到了黎曼猜想的证明，方法还能推广到广义黎曼猜想。
items.brief_en: Levent Alpöge says that he and Claude found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, and that the method extends to the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.
points_zh: 作者称，他与Claude已经找到黎曼猜想的证明，论证已形式化，并且不附加假设。作者认为，这个方法有望延伸到扩展黎曼猜想，但还需要更多时间。文中还说，在接近终点时，Claude大幅超过了作者。
points_en: The author says the arguments have been formalized without extra assumptions. The method may extend to the Extended Riemann Hypothesis with more time. The author also says Claude far outpaced them near the finish line.

items.title: Connect a USB Zigbee Device to HAOS
items.brief_zh: 要在运行HAOS的虚拟机里接入USB Zigbee棒，需要先用lsusb查到设备ID，再用virsh把它挂进虚拟机并设为持久化，之后才能在Home Assistant里添加设备。
items.brief_en: To use a USB Zigbee stick in HAOS, attach it to the virtual machine with virsh, then make the attachment persistent so Home Assistant can see it and add devices.
items.background_zh: 作者把一个Zigbee USB棒插进了运行HAOS的电脑，却在Home Assistant界面里找不到它，于是记录下了解决步骤。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是：USB挂载要设为持久化，之后就可以在Home Assistant里添加Zigbee设备。
items.background_en: The author plugged a Zigbee dongle into the computer running HAOS but could not find it in the Home Assistant interface, so they wrote down the fix.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that the USB attachment must be made persistent, after which Zigbee devices can be added in Home Assistant.
points_zh: 先在宿主机上用lsusb找到设备的两个ID。作者的例子是10c4:ea60，即Silicon Labs CP210x UART Bridge。把ID填进一个XML文件，格式为hostdev，并保留0x前缀。
用virsh attach-device把设备挂进HAOS虚拟机，虚拟机名称可以用virsh list查到。挂载后用virsh reboot重启虚拟机，等几分钟让系统恢复。
重启后，设备会出现在Settings → Devices的“Discovered”里。添加设备并完成提示后，重启Home Assistant，就可以从Settings → Connectivity → Zigbee开始添加Zigbee设备。
要让挂载永久生效，先用virsh detach-device移除设备，再加上--persistent参数重新挂载。
points_en: Find the device's two IDs on the host with lsusb. The example is 10c4:ea60, a Silicon Labs CP210x UART Bridge. Put the IDs into an XML file in the hostdev format, keeping the 0x prefix.
Attach the device to the HAOS virtual machine with virsh attach-device, using the VM name from virsh list. Then reboot the VM with virsh reboot and wait a few minutes.
The device appears under Discovered in Settings → Devices. After adding it and restarting Home Assistant, you can add Zigbee devices from Settings → Connectivity → Zigbee.
To make the attachment permanent, detach the device with virsh detach-device, then attach it again with the --persistent flag.

items.title: Max Headroom incident of Nov 22, 1987
items.brief_zh: 1987 年芝加哥那次 Max Headroom 假信号入侵至今没有破案，作者认为问题在于调查没有下足功夫，没有人去实地走访。
items.brief_en: The 1987 Max Headroom broadcast hijacking in Chicago was never solved. The author thinks the investigation failed because no one did the on-the-ground work.
items.background_zh: 1987 年 11 月 22 日，芝加哥两家电视台的节目先后被一个戴 Max Headroom 面具的人打断。作者是电脑安全从业者，有新闻学背景，借此回顾这起至今未破的事件。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者没有给出答案。他说追诉时效早在 1992 年就已经过了，政府不会再追查，并推测这些人可能是担心影响日后的工作，所以至今不愿露面。
items.background_en: On November 22, 1987, two Chicago TV stations had their broadcasts interrupted by a person wearing a Max Headroom mask. The author is a computer security professional with a journalism background, and revisits the unsolved case.
items.conclusion_en: The author does not name anyone. The statute of limitations expired in 1992, and the author suggests the pranksters may stay hidden to protect their future jobs.
points_zh: 两次入侵发生在同一个晚上，第二次比第一次更张扬。WGN 在插播芝加哥熊队比赛集锦时突然黑屏 15 秒，随后出现戴橡胶 Max Headroom 面具的人，背景是一块晃动的波纹金属板，工程师约 30 秒后才恢复播出。两个小时后，PBS 电视台 WTTW 播放《神秘博士》时再次被入侵，这次有声音。假 Max Headroom 调侃了 WGN、New Coke、Pepsi，还可能暗指 Michael Jackson 的单只手套，最后做出了不雅动作。
Max Headroom 是 1980 年代末 ABC 播出的短命反乌托邦科幻剧，讲一名记者的意识被复制进电脑、再由 AI 复活，结果变成一个故障、爱耍贫嘴的复制品。节目收视不如 Dallas 和 Miami Vice，第二季还没播完就被取消。但角色因可口可乐广告广为人知，所以 1987 年橡胶面具很容易买到。
FCC 和 FBI 把范围缩小到芝加哥的一个区域，那里能看到 Hancock 大楼和 Sears Tower，但最终没有查出是谁。作者从播音中的线索推断，对方年纪可能比普通恶作剧者大：他唱了 1966 年 Temptations 的歌词，还哼了动画 Clutch Cargo 的主题曲，而这部动画 1960 年就结束了。
作者认为案子没破，主要是因为调查方法不够扎实。FCC 在芝加哥没有人去敲门走访。作者说，自己会先查两家电视台里对公司有不满的员工，再问工会，顺着每一条线索一直查下去。
近年的几种推测都没有得到证实。一种说是一位芝加哥朋克乐手，他 2010 年去世，但他的乐队成员说他 1987 年不具备这种技术。一种来自 Reddit，说是两兄弟所为，但两人不愿谈，线索断了。还有一种说某所技术学校收到过电视设备捐赠，但作者找不到原帖，无从判断依据。社交媒体上常有人说自己知道是谁，却拿不出任何细节。
points_en: Two broadcasts were hijacked the same night, and the second was bolder. On WGN, Bears highlights were cut off by 15 seconds of black screen, then a figure in a rubber Max Headroom mask appeared with no clear audio. Engineers needed about 30 seconds to restore the feed. Two hours later, WTTW's Doctor Who broadcast was hijacked again, this time with audio. The voice joked about WGN, New Coke and Pepsi, possibly hinted at Michael Jackson with a single glove, and ended with a crude act.

Max Headroom was a short-lived dystopian sci-fi show on ABC in the late 1980s. It followed a journalist whose mind was copied into a computer and revived by AI as a glitchy, wisecracking copy. The show was cancelled before its second season ended and drew less viewership than Dallas and Miami Vice. The character was well known from Coca-Cola ads, so a rubber mask was easy to buy in 1987.

The FCC and FBI narrowed the location to an area of Chicago with a line of sight to the Hancock Building and Sears Tower, but never identified the pirate. The author reads clues from the broadcast as signs that the pirate may be older than a typical prankster. The pirate quoted a 1966 Temptations song and hummed the theme of Clutch Cargo, a cartoon that ended in 1960.

The author blames the failed case on weak legwork. The FCC had no one in Chicago knocking on doors. The author would have checked disgruntled employees at both stations, asked the union, and followed each lead to the end.

Recent theories remain unproven. One names a Chicago punk musician who died in 2010, but his bandmates say he lacked the skills in 1987. A Reddit thread named two brothers involved in phreaking, but they did not want to talk and the lead went cold. Another claimed a technical school received TV equipment, but the author could not find the original thread. Social media posts that claim to know the culprit offer no details.

items.title: Pluralistic: Lisa Hanawalt's "I Can't Stop Thinking About Horses and Sex" (20 Nov 2026)
items.brief_zh: Doctorow 推荐 Lisa Hanawalt 的图文回忆录，说这是一本聪明、好笑、坦率的书，能从创伤和忧郁里写出喜剧和洞察。
items.brief_en: Cory Doctorow calls Lisa Hanawalt's graphic memoir a wise, funny and frank book that finds comedy and insight in trauma.
items.background_zh: Lisa Hanawalt 是动画师，以《BoJack Horseman》的角色设计闻名。这本图文回忆录围绕她与喜剧演员、播客主持人 Adam Conover 的分手展开，两人同居了 14 年。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，这是一本聪明、好笑、坦率的书，把创伤和忧郁写得有洞察、有温度，读完仍会留在心里。
items.background_en: Lisa Hanawalt is an animator known as the character designer for Bojack Horseman. The graphic memoir centers on her breakup with comedian and podcaster Adam Conover, after 14 years together.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that this is a wise, funny and frank book that stays with the reader after they finish it.
points_zh: 这本书把分手和一匹马的故事编织在一起。小马 Juni 是 Hanawalt 情绪的支柱，也是心痛的来源，因为马很脆弱，随时可能受伤或突然死亡。
全书由一个个短小、细致的片段组成，画风把人和动物化的人物画得既滑稽、怪异，又带着性感。角色没有绝对的好人和坏人，优点和缺点往往是同一件事的两面。
书中还写到约会、童年性创伤、IBS，以及对生育的担忧，包括冻卵的经历，还有医疗系统对待女性的方式。
Conover 的脱口秀特辑《Big Divorce Energy》与这本书在同一周推出，两人还在 Conover 的播客 Factually 上聊过这段关系。实体书由 Drawn and Quarterly 出版，厚实的纸张和缝在书脊上的书签带都很讲究。
points_en: The book braids two stories: her breakup with Conover and her pony, Juni. Horses anchor her, but they are also a source of heartbreak, since they are fragile and can be injured or die suddenly.

The memoir is built from short, sharp vignettes. Hanawalt's art draws human and animal bodies as funny, strange and sexy at once. No one is purely a hero or a villain, and strengths and flaws are often two sides of one trait.
The book also covers dating, childhood sexual trauma, IBS, and fears about fertility, including egg freezing and how the medical system treats women.

Conover's comedy special about the breakup, Big Divorce Energy, came out the same week as the book, and the two recorded a conversation for Conover's Factually podcast. The Drawn and Quarterly hardcover has thick pages and a sewn-in ribbon bookmark.

items.title: Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube)
items.brief_zh: ChatPRD 的运营者 Claire Vo 说，有人滥用免费试用盗用 token，她决定完全停掉免费试用。
items.brief_en: ChatPRD's Claire Vo says token fraud from abused free trials is a serious problem, and she is ending free trials entirely.
items.background_zh: ChatPRD 是帮产品经理把想法写成产品规格的 AI 平台，从 GPT-4 时代就已上线。Claire Vo 在一段 YouTube 视频中讲述了她遇到的大量 token 滥用情况，Simon Willison 转发了这段视频。
items.conclusion_zh: Willison 认为，关闭免费试用虽然可惜，但看起来是应对滥用的正确决定。
items.background_en: ChatPRD is an AI platform that helps product managers turn an idea into a spec, and it has been live since the GPT-4 era. In a YouTube video, Claire Vo describes the large-scale token abuse she has seen. Simon Willison links to the video.
items.conclusion_en: Willison says that ending free trials is sad but looks like the right decision.
points_zh: 滥用者主要利用免费试用和促销码。有人只是想白用 AI，有人把 token 转卖，还有人在 ChatPRD 的 agent 上跑自己的商业项目。
Claire 发现，很多滥用请求的提示词都是要求生成“骑自行车的鹈鹕” SVG 图。Willison 推测，这类提示词可能被用来探测底层模型，因为不同模型家族的输出有明显特征。Willison 过去也用过类似办法，猜测 OpenRouter 上隐身预览模型的身份。
Claire 正在完全关闭免费试用，以应对这种滥用。
points_en: Abusers mainly exploit free trials and promo codes. Some want free AI usage, some resell tokens, and others run their own commercial projects on top of the ChatPRD agent.

Many abusive prompts asked for SVG pictures of pelicans riding bicycles. Willison guesses the scammers use this prompt to identify the underlying model family, since each family has a distinct signature. Willison has used a similar test to guess stealth preview models on OpenRouter.
Claire is winding down her free trials completely.

items.title: Another company I've never heard of lost my Data
items.brief_zh: 作者收到一家从未听说过的公司泄露数据的通知，认为只给一年免费信用监控，无法约束企业保护数据。
items.brief_en: The author received a breach notice from a company they had never heard of. They argue that one year of free credit monitoring does not discourage companies from losing data.
items.background_zh: Premise Health Holding 通知作者，公司一名员工从 2026 年 3 月起擅自改动客户数据，直到 9 月才被发现。通知称作者的姓名、住址和社会安全号受到影响，但作者从没和这家公司有过业务往来。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，除非对丢失的数据设定实质性的惩罚，而且这种损失无法挽回，否则这类事会一直是常态。
items.background_en: Premise Health Holding told the author that an employee changed customer data from March 2026, and the problem was found only in September. The notice said the author's name, address and Social Security number were affected, though the author never did business with the company.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that losses like this will remain routine unless companies face solid penalties for data that cannot be recovered.
points_zh: 企业泄露数据后的补偿太轻，作者认为一年免费信用监控远远不够。社会安全号无法更改，攻击者完全可以等监控期结束后再动手。另一家公司今年也曾向作者提供过一年监控，作者手上的监控还剩约六个月。
作者从没和 Premise Health Holding 有过业务往来，却收到了它的泄露通知。通知称，2026 年 3 月起有员工擅自改动客户数据，直到 9 月才被发现，作者的姓名、住址和社会安全号都在影响范围内。作者不明白这家公司为什么持有这些信息。
作者的孩子也收到过一封信，说孩子的个人信息被泄露，但这家人从没用过那家医院或保险公司。作者开玩笑说，这可能让孩子成了最年幼的身份被盗用者之一，同时也拥有一份免费信用监控。
points_en: One year of free credit monitoring is too weak a penalty, the author says. A Social Security number cannot change, so attackers can wait until monitoring ends. Another company that lost the author's data this year also offered a year of monitoring, and about six months remain.

The author has never done business with Premise Health Holding but received its notice. The company said an employee changed customer data from March to September 2026 before anyone noticed, affecting name, address and Social Security number. The author does not know why the company held this information.

The author's child also received a breach letter, although the family had not used the hospital or insurer that sent it. The author jokes that this may make the child one of the youngest identity theft victims, who also has free credit monitoring.

items.title: ★ Jon McCormack Retires From Apple
items.brief_zh: Gruber 撰文悼念 Jon McCormack，认为他是守住苹果相机应用方向的人。McCormack 已于 10 月底退休，留下的位置很难填补。
items.brief_en: Gruber pays tribute to Jon McCormack, who retired from Apple at the end of October. He calls McCormack the protector of the Camera app and says his departure leaves big shoes to fill.
items.background_zh: Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 报道，McCormack 在苹果工作八年多后于 10 月底退休。Gruber 与他多次见面，于是写下这篇纪念文章。
items.conclusion_zh: Gruber 认为 McCormack 是这份重要工作的理想人选，他留下的位置很难填补。
items.background_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that Jon McCormack retired after more than eight years at Apple. Gruber, who has met McCormack several times, wrote this tribute.
items.conclusion_en: Gruber calls McCormack the perfect person for an essential job and says he leaves big shoes to fill.
points_zh: 据 Bloomberg 报道，McCormack 10 月底退休，此前负责相机和照片应用及其底层技术。苹果没有任命新的副总裁接替，他的原下属转到另一位高管手下承担这些职责，苹果拒绝置评。
他的工作包括 iPhone 17 系列重新设计的前置自拍相机。这个方形传感器更大，成本更高，还占用更多内部空间，需要在苹果内部经过激烈争论才能推出。McCormack 本人说，iPhone 每天拍摄的自拍超过 10 亿张。
Gruber 认为，McCormack 最突出的能力是让糟糕的功能不进入相机应用。多位与他共事的人告诉 Gruber，他很擅长拒绝，而这比加入好功能更稀缺也更重要。
关于生成式 AI，Gruber 认为苹果在这方面仍然保守，但 Clean Up 已经推出，今年又加入了 extend 和 reframe。Gruber 不太喜欢后两者，因为它们改变了“什么是照片”的含义，但也不讨厌，并认为生成式 AI 已经无法收回。
points_en: Bloomberg reported that McCormack retired at the end of October. Apple has not named a new vice president. His former deputies now take on his duties under another executive. Apple declined to comment.

McCormack oversaw the Camera and Photos apps. His work included the redesigned selfie camera on the iPhone 17 lineup. Its bigger square sensor cost more and took up more space inside the phone, so it needed hard arguments inside Apple to ship. McCormack said over 1 billion selfies are taken on iPhones every day.

Gruber says McCormack's main strength was keeping weak ideas out of the Camera app. People who worked with him said he was great at saying no. Gruber thinks this skill is rarer and more important than shipping good features.

On generative AI, Gruber says Apple is still the conservative company. Even so, Apple shipped Clean Up and this year added extend and reframe. Gruber does not love extend or reframe because they change what a photo means, but he does not hate them. He says the generative AI genie cannot be put back in the bottle.

items.title: Google’s Spark AI Agent Becomes ‘Tasks’
items.brief_zh: Google 把 Spark AI 代理改名为 Tasks 并免费开放，美国、加拿大、日本、韩国、澳大利亚和印度的所有用户都能使用。
items.brief_en: Google renames its Spark AI agent Tasks and makes it free. Users in the US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and India can all use it.
items.background_zh: Spark 5 月首次推出时只对 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户开放。现在 Gemini 里的 Tasks 把它的功能带给了上述六个国家和地区的全部用户。
items.conclusion_zh: 文章最后落在使用方法上：打开 Gemini，把首页的“Chat”切换成“Tasks”，就能找到这个功能。
items.background_en: Google first launched Spark in May, and only AI Pro and Ultra subscribers could use it. Tasks in Gemini now brings its features to all users in those six countries and regions.
items.conclusion_en: The post ends with how to find the feature. Open Gemini and switch the homepage toggle from Chat to Tasks.
points_zh: Tasks 可以替用户做事，例如制定餐单、管理日历，或者从邮件里找出可能用不着的周期性支出。它由 Google 的新模型 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 驱动。
美国用户还能用更多功能：让代理打电话给商家比价、查库存，用 Google Pay 付款，并通过 Google Password Manager 登录账号。美国用户也可以发邮件或短信给 gemini@google.com 布置任务。
Google 说，每个任务都在为单一账号专门分配、且不与他人共享的硬件隔离虚拟机中运行。任务执行时可以补充指令；购买等敏感操作前，代理会先停下来请用户确认。
points_en: Tasks can build meal plans, manage your calendar, and search your emails for recurring expenses you may not need. It runs on Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model.

US users get more. The agent can call businesses to compare prices and check stock, buy items with Google Pay, and sign into accounts through Google Password Manager. US users can also assign tasks by emailing or texting gemini@google.com.

Google says each task runs in a hardware-isolated virtual machine dedicated to one account and never shared with others. Users can add instructions while a task runs. Before sensitive steps such as purchases, the agent stops and asks for permission.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released
items.brief_zh: 作者认为 PostgreSQL 19 值得等这么久，他最喜欢的新功能是 WAIT FOR LSN，它能让读备库的应用读到刚刚写入的数据。
items.brief_en: The author says PostgreSQL 19 was worth the wait. His favorite new feature is WAIT FOR LSN, which lets standby reads see data that was just written.
items.background_zh: PostgreSQL 通常每年 9 月发版，今年晚了两个月，主要是团队忙于处理大量由 AI 报告的安全漏洞。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，这次发版确实值得等。
items.background_en: PostgreSQL usually ships in September. This release came two months later, mainly because the team had to handle many security issues reported with AI.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that this release was definitely worth the wait.
points_zh: WAIT FOR LSN 为读副本提供“读己所写”的一致性。应用写入后先取得当前的 WAL 位置并保存，比如放进签名 cookie 里；之后在备库上执行 WAIT FOR LSN，等它回放到该位置，再查询数据。可以设置超时时间，副本超时未追上时会报错。
这种做法并不新。MediaWiki 早就在 MySQL 复制上用类似方法实现：把主库的 binlog 位置存在会话里，每次请求开始时等副本追上再读。现在它改用 WAIT_FOR_EXECUTED_GTID_SET()，旧环境则退回到 SOURCE_POS_WAIT()。
points_en: WAIT FOR LSN adds read-your-writes consistency for read replicas. After a write, the app saves the current WAL position, for example in a signed cookie. Later, the standby waits until it has replayed up to that position before the query runs. An optional timeout returns an error if the replica does not catch up in time.

The pattern is not new. MediaWiki already does something similar on MySQL replication. It stores the primary's binlog position in the session and waits for the replica to catch up at the start of each request. It now uses WAIT_FOR_EXECUTED_GTID_SET() and falls back to SOURCE_POS_WAIT().

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6
items.brief_zh: 评测作者认为 GTA VI 兑现了多年的期待，是 GTA V 的合格继任者，也是开放世界游戏的新标杆。
items.brief_en: The reviewer says GTA VI lives up to years of hype. It is a worthy successor to GTA V and a new standard for open-world games.
items.background_zh: GTA V 卖出超过 2.3 亿份。GTA VI 经历多次延期和泄露后，将于 11 月 19 日登陆 PS5 和 Xbox。这篇评测是评测作者在首发版 PS5 上玩了近 80 小时后写的。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者认为 GTA VI 没有辜负等待。游戏本身足够好，以至于外界的炒作成了最不值得说的部分。
items.background_en: GTA V has sold more than 230 million copies. After many delays and leaks, GTA VI launches on PS5 and Xbox on November 19. The review is based on nearly 80 hours of play on a launch-version PS5.
items.conclusion_en: The reviewer says GTA VI delivers on the wait. The game is so good that the hype is the least interesting thing about it.
points_zh: 游戏的核心是双主角的故事，讲的是 Jason Duval 和 Lucia Caminos 两个小罪犯的类似邦妮和克莱德的爱情故事。它把 GTA V 的开放自由与 Red Dead Redemption 2 的沉浸感结合起来，是系列里最成熟的一作。前期两人大多单独行动，大约 17 小时后才能自由切换。
任务和赚钱方式自由度很高：可以抢珠宝店、偷车、突袭毒窝，还能去海底找宝藏，再把赃物卖给销赃者（fence）。多步骤抢劫比以前更复杂。新的存档点系统减少了重复游玩，失败太多次还能直接跳过任务。
世界里有很多小细节，但不会变成负担。NPC 可以打招呼或挑衅，手机融入了游戏世界，换衣服、吃喝、加油等设定增加了真实感，却不会拖慢节奏。牵手、递咖啡这些互动还会影响两人的关系。
缺点是战斗笨拙、武器轮难用，还有一些小 bug。不过技术问题很少，评测作者说游戏在 PS5 上运行得很好。
体量非常大。评测作者玩了超过 70 小时，主线通关后仍只完成了不到 60%。作者认为它是继 Red Dead Redemption 2 之后最有说服力的开放世界游戏，这个位置现在交给了 GTA VI。
points_en: The story centers on two small-time criminals, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, in a Bonnie and Clyde style romance. The game combines GTA V's open freedom with the immersion of Red Dead Redemption 2, and it is the most mature GTA so far. The two leads mostly play alone at first. Free switching between them opens up about 17 hours in.

The ways to make money are very open. You can rob jewelry stores, steal cars, raid drug dens, or search for treasure at the bottom of the sea. Then you sell loot to fences. Multi-step heists are bigger and more complex than before. A new checkpoint system cuts replay time, and you can skip a mission after too many failures.

The world has many small details that do not become a chore. NPCs can be greeted or taunted, and the phone is part of the world. Clothes, food, and fuel add realism without slowing the pace. Holding hands and handing over coffee also improve the relationship between the leads.
The weak points are clunky combat, a frustrating weapon wheel, and some small bugs. Technical problems are rare, and the game ran well on PS5.

The game is very large. The reviewer played more than 70 hours and had finished less than 60 percent of the total experience after completing the main story. The reviewer says it is the most convincing open-world game since Red Dead Redemption 2, and that title now passes to GTA VI.

items.title: The New Era Of Dark Social Is Here
items.brief_zh: 作者认为“暗社交”正在进入新阶段，越来越多的人转向群聊来分享和交流。
items.brief_en: The author argues that dark social is entering a new era as people move in large numbers to group chats.
items.background_zh: 2012年，Alexis Madrigal在《大西洋月刊》上提出“dark social”这个说法，指通过邮件、聊天和私信传播的链接。分析工具统计不到这些流量，营销人员一直把它看成盲区。
items.background_en: Alexis Madrigal coined 'dark social' in The Atlantic in 2012. The term describes links shared by email, chat and DMs, which analytics tools could not measure, so marketers saw it as a blind spot.
points_zh: 文章的主张是，人们正大量迁往群聊，暗社交因此进入新时代。正文在付费墙处就断了，具体论据和数据都看不到。
points_en: The post's claim is that people are joining an exodus to group chats, which marks a new era for dark social. The text stops at a paywall, so the evidence is not visible.

items.title: Closing The Sandwich Shop
items.brief_zh: 作者认为，媒体必须掌握自己的基础设施，把命运交给别人的平台，最终会付出代价。
items.brief_en: The author argues that media outlets must control their own infrastructure, because handing it to other companies eventually costs them.
items.background_zh: Salon停刊了，它是网上存在时间最长的几家新闻网站之一，停刊时给出的理由是独立数字新闻的商业模式已经不可持续。作者借这件事谈媒体长期依赖别人平台的问题。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，媒体要自己掌握基础设施和未来，不能把决定权交给别人。他还提到Virginian-Pilot页面底部禁止用于AI训练的声明，认为媒体已经被伤得太多，不会再对这件事客气。
items.background_en: Salon, one of the longest-running news sites, shut down and said its publishing model was no longer sustainable. The author uses its history to look at how news outlets depend on other companies' platforms.
items.conclusion_en: Media outlets should control their own infrastructure and future instead of leaving those choices to others. The author says outlets have been burned too often to stay polite about AI training, and he points to a no-AI-training notice at the bottom of a Virginian-Pilot page as evidence.
points_zh: Salon在2011年关掉了用了十几年的评论区软件。作者认为这类把基础设施交给别人的决定，削弱了网站的势能和根基，但他也说这个判断不一定对。
Salon一直靠搭上搜索、社交和视频等技术潮流才撑下来，它自己并没有创造这些潮流。它早期的种子资金来自Apple和Adobe，Adobe后来还持续支持了好几年。
Salon后来被Find.co收购，这家公司总部在马耳他，业务涉及iGaming和加密货币。作者猜测买家要的是它的谷歌排名和SEO流量，而不是这家媒体本身，但他说自己可能看错了。
大平台的押注会迫使整个行业跟着变。Google的AI Mode据报道盈利不如旧版搜索，Google因此在测试减少它的展示。作者把这和Facebook当年依据不准确数据推动的“转向视频”相比。
自上而下的决定往往不看实际情况。作者以William & Mary学生抗议保住一家Wawa门店为例，说明Wawa想增加带加油站的门店，是在高处做决定，和科技公司的很多做法一样。
points_en: Salon shut its long-running comment section in 2011. The author thinks decisions like this weakened the site's momentum and foundations, though he says he is not sure.
Salon rode search, social and video trends to survive, but it did not create them. It got early seed funding from Apple and Adobe, and Adobe kept supporting it for years.

Salon was sold to Find.co, a Malta-based company with crypto and iGaming interests. The author suspects the buyer wanted Salon's Google ranking and SEO traffic more than the outlet itself, though he says he could be wrong.

Big platform bets force the whole industry to react. Google's AI Mode was reportedly less profitable than old search, and Google is testing ways to reduce it. The author compares this to Facebook's video pivot, which was based on inflated data.
Top-down decisions ignore what happens on the ground. The author uses a protest by William & Mary students to save a Wawa store as an example, since Wawa wants more stores with gas stations.

items.title: Anthropic IPOs, Topping SpaceX for the Largest Ever
items.brief_zh: Gruber 简短表达了对 Anthropic 上市的怀疑：他认为大模型的优势并不持久，而且公司领导层不适合管理上市公司。
items.brief_en: John Gruber doubts Anthropic's IPO, saying LLM advantages are temporary and the leadership is not fit to run a public company.
detail_zh: 这只是一段简短的评论，回应的是 Anthropic 上市规模超过 SpaceX、史上最大这一新闻。Gruber 提出两点怀疑。第一，大模型没有长久的护城河，前沿的领先只是暂时的，而且这种优势建立在 Nvidia 的黄仁勋等人推高的巨大泡沫之上。第二，即使他在第一点上判断错了，他也认为 Anthropic 的领导层不适合带领一家上市公司，他用的措辞相当尖锐。
这段话没有给出数据或更多论证，主要是作者的个人看法。
detail_en: This is a short reaction to the news that Anthropic's IPO is the largest ever, above SpaceX. Gruber gives two doubts. First, LLMs have no lasting moat, only a temporary lead at the frontier, and that lead rests on a huge bubble that Nvidia's Jensen Huang has helped inflate. Second, even if he is wrong about the first point, he thinks the leadership is not fit to run a public company, and he uses harsh language.
The excerpt gives no data or further argument, so it is mainly the author's personal opinion.

items.title: My Least Favorite Example in Software Engineering
items.brief_zh: 作者最讨厌的是属性测试（PBT）入门里反复出现的“反转两次列表”例子，它能说明概念，却和真实测试没有关系。
items.brief_en: The author thinks the 'reverse a list twice' example is a poor way to teach property-based testing (PBT), even though it explains the concept.
items.background_zh: 作者写教学例子很讲究，认为好例子要让人理解主题，也要说明主题为什么重要。他为Brooklyn Web Workers的一场闪电演讲准备了这篇文章，想讲清楚这个例子为什么这么流行。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者认为“反转两次列表”能说明属性是什么，但作为PBT的教学例子并不好。有状态的属性更直观也更有用；如果只能用纯函数，roundtrip和oracle是比较好的选择。
items.background_en: The author cares about teaching examples that help readers understand a topic and why it matters. He prepared this post for a lightning talk at Brooklyn Web Workers, to explain why this example became so common.
items.conclusion_en: The double-reverse example can show what a property is, but the author does not think it is a good teaching example for PBT. He recommends state-based properties, and roundtrips or oracles when only pure functions are available.
points_zh: 好的教学例子应同时满足四条：足够简单，能清楚展示主题，贴近真实世界中主题的出现方式，并且能让读者找到同类例子。
很多PBT入门都用reverse(reverse(l)) == l这个例子。作者不满意，因为它只说明了PBT是什么，没有告诉读者怎样用在真实软件上，而且几乎没有人会在工作中反转列表。
这个例子流行有两个原因。一是简单、好记、好分享，并且不依赖具体语言；二是John Hughes在QuickCheck论文的开头就用了它，后来的人都跟着用。
这个例子并非Hughes首创。Zohar Manna、Boyer和Moore，以及Richard Bird和Philip Wadler的书里都用过它，但用途是证明程序性质，而不是测试。作者认为Hughes没有责任选一个更好的例子。
作者在2026年11月19日的更新中给出了替代思路。他更推荐有状态的属性，例如“与Web应用的任何交互都不应导致500 Internal Server Error”，或者在多次API调用之间保持数据模型不变。纯函数场景下，他推荐roundtrip（如to_json(from_json(x)) == x）和oracle（如f(x) == 优化版f(x)）。
points_en: Good teaching examples should be simple, show the topic clearly, match how the topic appears in real work, and help readers find similar examples.

Most property-based testing introductions use reverse(reverse(l)) == l. The author dislikes it because it shows what PBT is but not how to use it on real software, and few people reverse lists at work.
The example spread for two reasons. It is easy to remember and share, and it does not depend on a language. It was also the opening example in John Hughes's QuickCheck paper, so others copied it.

The example was already used before Hughes. Zohar Manna, Boyer and Moore, and Richard Bird and Philip Wadler used it to prove properties, not to test them. The author says Hughes had no responsibility to pick a better example.

In a November 19, 2026 update, the author suggests better examples. He prefers state-based properties, such as 'no interaction with the web app should cause a 500 Internal Server Error', or keeping data model invariants across API calls. For pure functions, he likes roundtrips like to_json(from_json(x)) == x and oracles that compare against an optimized version.

items.title: Pluralistic: How to forfeit one of copyright's best labor policies (19 Nov 2026)
items.brief_zh: 作者认为，50年来版权不断扩张并没有让创作者变富，真正管用的版权转让终止权（termination of transfer）正被片商和唱片公司用loan-out公司的说法绕开。
items.brief_en: The author argues that copyright expansion has not helped creators, and that termination of transfer, which lets artists reclaim rights after 35 years, is being undermined by loan-out companies.
items.background_zh: 1976年版权法规定，创作者可以在35年后撤销版权转让。近年来法院的一系列判决偏向片商和唱片公司，它们主张loan-out公司让这项权利失效，作者担心这条对创作者有利的规则会被架空。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者认为，应该兑现1976年法案草稿里承诺的自动终止权，不能让loan-out结构把它削弱。他提醒创作者，如果担心这个问题，就去找自己的律师和会计师。他还推荐Authors Alliance提供的免费工具，帮助作者终止旧的版权转让、拿回权利。
items.background_en: Since 1976, creators can end copyright transfers after 35 years. Recent court rulings have sided with studios and labels that say loan-out companies block this right, which worries the author.
items.conclusion_en: The author wants the automatic termination right promised in the 1976 draft restored, and he warns that loan-out structures should not weaken it. He advises creators worried about this to talk to their own lawyers and accountants, and he points to a free Authors Alliance tool for terminating old transfers.
points_zh: 版权扩张并没有帮到创作者。作者说，50年来版权的期限、范围和处罚都在加强，但创作者平均比1976年更穷，媒体公司却更富。原因是创作者面对的只是少数几家大买家，议价能力很弱，多给的版权最后都会在合同里被收走。
终止权是少数被证明有效的条款。创作者可以在35年后撤销版权转让，即使合同里写了不行使也没用。35年前的作品多半是职业生涯初期签的，条件通常很差，而其中不少作品至今仍然赚钱。

终止权确实让创作者拿回了收益。Rebecca Giblin等人的研究发现，它让创作者变富，对黑人“传统”音乐人尤其有帮助。作者还列举了The Baby-Sitters Club和Sweet Valley High的作者、Stephen King、Peter Straub，以及迪士尼在终止权的威胁下向Stan Lee、Steve Ditko和Jack Kirby等人支付的大额款项。最近，Wachowskis也宣布要行使终止权，收回《黑客帝国》。
国会先许诺、后削弱。1976年法案的草稿规定20年后自动终止，最终版本改为35年，还要办大量手续。1999年，国会助理Mitch Glazier在一项无关法案里加入条款，让大多数唱片艺人无法行使终止权，后来国会召开特别会议撤销了这条修正。Glazier之后成为RIAA的CEO。
现在最大的威胁来自loan-out公司。很多自由职业者通过LLC与雇主签约，片商和唱片公司据此主张这些作品是“职务作品”，终止权不适用。在John Waite诉UMG的案子中，法院支持了UMG。作者引用Aaron Moss的说法，称这是“定时炸弹”。作者还提出一种可能的绕开办法：合同把版税和预付款付给loan-out公司，但版权仍留在创作者本人名下。他也说自己没有确定答案，建议咨询律师和会计师。
points_en: Longer and broader copyright has not helped creators. Over 50 years, copyright has grown, but artists are poorer and media companies are richer. Artists face a few big buyers, so any extra rights get signed away in contracts.

Termination of transfer lets creators cancel a copyright transfer after 35 years, and they cannot contract out of it. Works made early in a career are often signed on bad terms, and many still earn money decades later.

Termination has worked. A study by Rebecca Giblin and co-authors found it made artists richer, especially Black heritage musicians. The author cites authors of The Baby-Sitters Club and Sweet Valley High, Stephen King, Peter Straub, and Marvel creators who got large payouts from Disney under the threat of termination. The Wachowskis have announced they will use termination to reclaim The Matrix.

Congress promised more and then weakened it. The 1976 draft had automatic termination after 20 years, but the final law set 35 years and added paperwork. In 1999, staffer Mitch Glazier slipped a clause into an unrelated bill that blocked most recording artists from terminating. Congress held a special session to cancel it, and Glazier later became CEO of the RIAA.

Loan-out companies are now the main threat. Many freelancers sign through LLCs, and studios argue those works are works made for hire, so termination does not apply. Courts have mostly sided with them, including in John Waite's case against UMG. The author suggests paying royalties to the loan-out company while keeping copyright with the creator, but he says he has no firm answer.
